title: 曲がりケーブルトレイ
description: 床面と側面に実際の開口、曲線リブ、端部接続金具を備えた90度ケーブルトレイ単体。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A single 90-degree cable tray elbow with genuine deck and side-wall apertures, curved stiffening lips and end splice hardware. Decorative geometry, not a rated electrical product. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
